20261121-chemistry-g12-1.material: Mmeghachi omume gas exothermic na-esonụ nọ na dynamic equilibrium n'ime arịa mechiri emechi:  N₂(g) + 3H₂(g) ⇌ 2NH₃(g) + okpomọkụ (ΔH < 0).  Kedu ọnọdụ kacha mma a ga-edozi iji bulie mmepụta ammonia (NH₃) n'ọnọdụ equilibrium?
20261121-chemistry-g12-1.s.s1.prompt: Mmeghachi omume gas exothermic na-esonụ nọ na dynamic equilibrium n'ime arịa mechiri emechi:  N₂(g) + 3H₂(g) ⇌ 2NH₃(g) + okpomọkụ (ΔH < 0).  Kedu ọnọdụ kacha mma a ga-edozi iji bulie mmepụta ammonia (NH₃) n'ọnọdụ equilibrium?
20261121-chemistry-g12-1.s.s1.explain: Ebe ọ bụ mmeghachi omume exothermic ($\Delta H < 0$), a ga-ewedata okpomọkụ ka mmeghachi omume n'ihu na-ahapụ okpomọkụ nwee ike ịchị. Ọzọkwa, ebe mole gas na-ebelata site na $4\text{ mol} \rightarrow 2\text{ mol}$, a ga-ebuli nrụgide ka equilibrium gaa n'ihu na-ebelata ọnụọgụ molecule.

20261122-chemistry-g12-1.title: Njirimara ngwọta dị elu (colligative properties)
20261122-chemistry-g12-1.goal: Tinye ụkpụrụ nke Njirimara ngwọta dị elu (colligative properties) iji dozie nsogbu nnyocha.
20261122-chemistry-g12-1.material: [Njirimara ngwọta dị elu (colligative properties)] Kedu nhọrọ na-egosi naanị nkwupụta niile ziri ezi banyere ọdịdị (colligative properties) nke ngwọta dilute nwere nonvolatile, nonelectrolyte solute? (i) Ọ na-adabere naanị n'ọnụọgụ solute particles (molality), na-anaghị eche ụdị solute. (ii) Nrụgide uzuoku dị ala karịa nke solvent dị ọcha ma ebe ọkụ na-abawanye. (iii) Usoro osmotic pressure nke van't Hoff bụ Π = cRT, nke yiri usoro ideal gas.
20261122-chemistry-g12-1.s.s1.prompt: [Njirimara ngwọta dị elu (colligative properties)] Kedu nhọrọ na-egosi naanị nkwupụta niile ziri ezi banyere ọdịdị (colligative properties) nke ngwọta dilute nwere nonvolatile, nonelectrolyte solute? (i) Ọ na-adabere naanị n'ọnụọgụ solute particles (molality), na-anaghị eche ụdị solute. (ii) Nrụgide uzuoku dị ala karịa nke solvent dị ọcha ma ebe ọkụ na-abawanye. (iii) Usoro osmotic pressure nke van't Hoff bụ Π = cRT, nke yiri usoro ideal gas.
20261122-chemistry-g12-1.s.s1.explain: Njirimara colligative nke ngwọta na-adabere naanị n'ọnụọgụ particles na-anaghị eche ụdị kemịkalụ nke solute, ma ha gụnyere ịwedata nrụgide uzuoku, ịbuli ebe ọkụ, ịwedata ebe oyi na osmotic pressure ($\Pi = cRT$), ya mere (i), (ii), (iii) niile ziri ezi.
